about: The training spots of the combat training engine: the one list to extend (members spots later too). scripts/data/build-trainers.ts checks every entry against the OSRS Wiki and writes src/data/generated/trainers.json; build-combat-foes.ts takes the opponents from here. A spot is either written out ('place', 'npcNames', 'goal', 'where', optional 'waypoints') or 'location' (a {{LocLine}} of the opponent's wiki article: the spawn nearest the middle is the place). 'bank' is a bank of majorLocations.json, the one the player really walks to (a straight line can cross a river or a toll gate). 'sell' is the always-drop worth picking up for money, checked against the wiki's drop table. 'levels' are the opponent versions standing there (combatFoes.json); absent, every free version. 'name' is how the guide says them ("the cows", "Train on Giant frogs"); 'proper' when it is one named opponent ("Fight Brutus").

spots.name: cows
spots.bankWhy: The cow field is across the bridge from Lumbridge Castle.

place.label: The cow field east of Lumbridge

spots.goal: The cow field east of Lumbridge
spots.where: The cow field north-east of Lumbridge Castle, across the river (Lumbridge cow field).

spots.name: Minotaurs
spots.bankWhy: There is no bank on the floor, bank in Edgeville first.

place.label: The Stronghold of Security entrance, Barbarian Village mine

spots.goal: Stronghold of Security floor 1: the level 12 Minotaurs

waypoints.label: The Stronghold of Security entrance: climb down
Floor 1 (Vault of War): the level 12 Minotaurs

spots.where: The Stronghold of Security, floor 1 (the Vault of War): the level 12 Minotaurs (the level 27 ones are further in). The entrance is in the Barbarian Village mine. There is no bank on the floor: bank in Edgeville first.

spots.name: Giant frogs
spots.bankWhy: Refill food at Lumbridge Castle bank.
spots.where: Fight level 13 Giant frogs on the surface of Lumbridge Swamp, south of Lumbridge Castle. Do not enter the caves: those frogs are level 99. Refill food at Lumbridge Castle bank.

spots.name: Hill Giants

place.label: The trapdoor to the Edgeville Dungeon

waypoints.label: The trapdoor to the Edgeville Dungeon: climb down

spots.where: The Hill Giants in the Edgeville Dungeon: the trapdoor is in Edgeville, a few steps south-west of the bank, and the giants are in the south-east of the dungeon. If you have a Brass key, the locked door by the giants saves the walk past the skeletons. The Edgeville bank is a minute away.

spots.name: barbarians
spots.label: Barbarian Village: the barbarians
spots.where: The barbarians of Barbarian Village, around the long hall by the Stronghold of Security entrance. Most are level 10, a few level 17; none attack first. Bank in Edgeville, north along the road.

spots.name: Al Kharid warriors
spots.label: Al Kharid palace: the warriors
spots.where: The warriors in the Al Kharid palace. When you attack one, the others nearby join in: pull one aside before fighting. The Al Kharid bank is just west of the palace.

spots.name: monks
spots.label: Edgeville Monastery: the monks
spots.where: The monks on the ground floor of Edgeville Monastery, west of Edgeville. Instead of eating, talk to a monk and ask to be healed: 2 + 20% of your Hitpoints each time. Bank in Edgeville.

spots.name: Brutus
spots.label: Brutus's pen, Lumbridge cow field
spots.where: Brutus in his pen in the north of the cow field east of Lumbridge, open after The Ides of Milk. Step aside when he winds up a charge or a stomp: they hit up to 19. He comes back about 22 seconds after each kill. Bank at Lumbridge Castle.
spots.betweenWhy: The wiki's respawn, 36 ticks (21.6 s), and a few seconds to walk back into place.
